name: Acadian Architectural Woodwork
old_description: Acadian Architectural's craftsmen have over 40 years of experience providing high-quality building materials to South Louisiana. They are dedicated to preserving the region's unique architectural heritage while seamlessly integrating it with modern living.
about:
Acadian Architectural Woodwork is based in Ponchatoula, Louisiana, where its craftsmen have accumulated over 40 years of experience providing high-quality building materials to South Louisiana. The company does not publish a founding date, ownership details, or founder names, but its legacy is tied to preserving the region’s unique architectural heritage while integrating it with modern living.

The firm manufactures both custom-designed and stock millwork products, including staircases, crown molding, and base molding. Its online catalog features two named design collections—Coastal Retreat Designs (four products) and Southern Urban Designs (five products)—with custom pieces available through direct sales and stock items shipped nationwide. Custom orders require additional manufacturing time.

Primary customers include residential builders, DIY enthusiasts, and design professionals seeking architectural millwork for Gulf Coast-style homes. The company serves the broader U.S. market via its e-commerce platform, offering support services during Central Time business hours (9 a.m. to 4 p.m.).

Acadian Architectural differentiates itself through its deep regional expertise and commitment to blending traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design, a philosophy reflected in its curated design collections and direct-sales approach for custom work.
